question: Why must all things be affirmed as having the nature of Śiva despite instrumental limits?
premises: Śiva-nature is not admitted in speech merely as an instrument.
The limitation belongs to the instrumental form, not the ultimate ground.
The same ground underlies all manifestations.
inference: Therefore, all is of the nature of Śiva.
plain_english: It is not accepted as such through speech as an instrument; therefore, all is of the nature of Śiva.
